message: These are useful low-priority diagnostic spikes, not all ready-to-run training assignments. Read spikes03-ack01: BD18 StageA accepted and19/21/22 prerequisite inspection; no restart or duplicate job requested. Apply below to existing work and preserve earlier evidence. Prioritize18 statistical audit and22 contract-QA; then bounded19/21 when resident tools/input provenance suffice.20 benchmark preparation only;23 deferred implementation pending explicit experiment contract;24 inventory only. NUIAK217 terminal received as peer report, independent acceptance pending; no promotion.
common: 108 procedural pairs are not324 independent samples: BD12's324 scores must first map to unique pair/scene/seed/derivative groups and model hashes. Keep model scores for the same source together across all splits; report independent-group count. Previously trained/exposed examples are fit diagnostics, never zero-shot or independent tests for those models.

Split groups before threshold fitting, prompt/model choice or probe training. Leave test groups untouched after selection; per-condition analyses are descriptive unless separately preregistered and sufficiently supported. Bootstrap whole independent groups with paired resampling for model comparisons, not individual patches, frames or repeated model scores. Report small samples as inconclusive.

Every result identifies the actual task: focus identity/state, spatial box localization, transition change, motion or temporal stability. Do not rename a changed-image score as focus movement or false-stable probability. Preserve no-op, content-only, scroll-with-fixed-focus and focus-change-with-fixed-box slices.

Use existing resident dependencies and approved inputs. New model/dataset downloads, installs, licence acceptance or services need the applicable maintainer approval; this review grants none. Inspect exact code, checkpoint and dataset/embedded-media terms separately; licence assertions in a request are not verification.

Keep per-spike executable/model/data pins, resource and disk estimate, seed/group manifests, actual start/terminal records, per-case outcomes, runtime failures and abstentions. Record preparation/load/inference timings separately, batch/resolution/quantization, p50/p95 and sample counts. Fixed seed is not a bitwise-reproducibility guarantee.

No blanket30GPU-hour launch: original stage estimates and optional StageB work do not define a consistent dispatch budget. Freeze model-count/seed-count/steps, per-spike wall/output caps and aggregate remaining budget before each existing authorized launch. One GPU at a time; yield at safe checkpoints to higher-priority NUIAK work, never terminate another job.

NUIAK intake uses named immutable SMB artifacts plus exact size/hash receipts under its existing authority; do not assume TTR's LAN HTTP route authorizes NUIAK HTTP intake. TTR may retain its separately approved route. Compact JSON/Markdown on SMB first; originals retained; no expiry-based deletion. No model-driven navigation, label repair, data admission, promotion or automatic recurrence.

tasks.decision: Proceed with resident statistical feasibility audit, not a safety guarantee
tasks.requirements: Define false-stable numerator/denominator explicitly (unstable predicted stable versus errors among emitted stable decisions) and distinguish marginal conformal coverage from conditional accepted-prediction risk. Audit whether BD12 contains temporal-stability labels at all; focus-change labels alone cannot establish settled rendering. Zero observed hard cases is not proof of low future risk. Deduplicate324scores to original108pairs/groups before calibration/test split. Standard split-conformal needs an explicit nonconformity score and exchangeability assumptions; it does not guarantee conditional false-stable risk under domain shift. Report risk-coverage curves, held-out counts, one-sided upper error bounds where independent trials justify them, and group-bootstrap uncertainty. Do not pass merely because a confidence interval contains1% or5%. With54 independent held-out examples and0errors, the exact one-sided95% binomial upper bound is about5.4%; fewer independent groups weaken evidence further. Return support shortfall and recommended new groups; no native safety claim or threshold adoption.

tasks.decision: Prioritize existing-validator planted-error trial; optional tools require resident/dependency check
tasks.requirements: Use immutable copies with an external truth ledger; freeze corruption locations/seeds and unchanged controls. A CC0 artwork image has no focus/box/order/role ground truth simply because its licence permits reuse. Use it only for applicable pixel/duplicate corruption, or explicitly authored diagnostic annotations. Compare current NUIAK-compatible validators first. Role and ancestry errors require manifest-aware checks and cannot be judged by visual QA packages alone. Report confusion counts/precision/recall and flag rate separately for each corruption type; do not pool easy exact duplicates with hard semantic mistakes to pass70%. Near-identical focus pairs are intentional; similarity flags must not delete them. Include actual prior failures: identical pixels/conflicting boxes, missing telemetry, partial publication, wrong source binding, cross-split ancestry and prediction-derived labels. No automatic relabel/delete.

tasks.decision: Resident-model diagnostic only once inputs and executable budget are pinned
tasks.requirements: Separate full-frame, algorithm-selected crop and ground-truth-oracle crop arms. Oracle focus boxes or changed regions chosen using labels are upper bounds, not deployable improvements. Freeze algorithm crop/diff generation independently of test labels; hold wording/output schema/model/decoding settings fixed. Evaluate focus change separately from general visual change; no-diff controls alone are too easy. Include content-only and scrolling counterexamples, none/uncertain/invalid outputs and coverage. Report paired effect intervals; do not change production escalation prompts from procedural-only success. Do not download Qwen weights or install quantization tooling without separate authority.

tasks.decision: Frozen-feature probe is relevant; no distillation or installation granted
tasks.requirements: Inventory resident exact DINO variants first; quantify memory and approved licence/model availability. Train probe only on named training groups; class-balance inside/outside patches and report per-frame center-hit/box IoU or segmentation metrics in addition to patch scores. Patches from one frame cannot cross splits or inflate independent sample count. Add coordinate-only and same-frame/identity controls to detect location/template shortcuts. Frozen feature extraction stays frozen; tune probe/regularization on development only. Compare paired held-out differences and group-level uncertainty; non-overlapping separate confidence intervals are not the required test. Motion-feature AUROC does not prove focus identity. Optional10k-frame distillation remains separate.

tasks.decision: NUIAK confirms benchmark-design/preflight scope only; multi-model execution pending matched contract
tasks.requirements: First verify exact public benchmark/weights availability, terms, label semantics and tvOS relevance; do not assume187 samples or compatibility. FocusRing classifies a supplied crop, it does not locate a whole-screen box. The transition model consumes two frames; a single-frame VLM has different inputs. Define separate single-frame localization and paired-transition tracks. A fair FocusRing localization system needs actual non-oracle candidate proposals and includes proposal failures; oracle boxes are a separate ceiling. Pin exact NUIAK artifact and any VLM weights; do not assert NUIAK lead from incompatible metrics or an underpowered failure. On8GBVRAM, inventory capacity and one-model feasibility before proposing four downloads. No transfer/install/download or benchmark training granted by this confirmation.

tasks.decision: Defer new detector training/export; scope/design and licence inventory only
tasks.requirements: Our current blocker is retaining existing classes and correctly labeling focus, not evidence that a newer detector is better. Define focused-body box versus focus-ring pixels; they are different labels/tasks. Pin actual implementations/checkpoints and review exact terms before proposing dependencies. Compare matched data/groups and both compute budget and converged-quality conditions;3seeds are not automatic statistical power. Existing YOLO11 data/model tests remain the reference. ONNX is not the existing FocusRing trace-to-CoreML path; export smoke alone proves neither supported Apple conversion nor preprocessing/output parity/latency. Any new detector/export path requires its own approved experiment after18/22 findings and native-source qualification. No automatic StageB12GPU-hour launch.

Inventory genuine action-linked ordered sequences with timestamps, observed focus identities/boxes, no-op/action failures, scene/episode grouping and source rights. Pair counts alone do not establish enough trajectories; report independent episodes and action support. Ground-truth next-frame difference uses future information unavailable to an action-conditioned predictor: label it oracle retrospective, and use persistence/no-motion and action-conditioned simple baselines for fair prediction. No15M-parameter training or MotionJEPA dependency until the action-conditioned task, data sufficiency, budget and held-out episode protocol are explicitly accepted. Do not request new capture from this inventory alone.

acceptance: Return exact request/amendment acknowledgment and a compact readiness table for18-24: resident inputs/model/tool availability, real task/label definition, independent groups, dependencies/approvals, chosen bounded budget and next action. Keep current task IDs, do not duplicate assignments. Report18/22 partial diagnostics promptly even if model downloads or native StageB are blocked.
